profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Your name
profile.languageHint: Stored with your profile. Use the language menu to change the screen language.

consents.title: Your data choices
consents.intro: Each choice is separate and applies only to the purpose described. Withdrawing consent stops that use going forward.
consents.saved: Your choices are saved. You can change them any time.

matching.title: Match me to buyer leads
matching.body: We use your business details and listings to match you with buyer enquiries. Without this we cannot send you leads.

sharing.title: Share my contact with matched buyers
sharing.body: When you accept a lead, the buyer sees your business name, city and phone so you can talk. Without this you cannot accept leads.

marketing.title: Send me tips and offers (optional)
marketing.body: Occasional product updates and selling tips. Not needed to use the service.

company.title: Company profile
company.description: Your legal details, checked against the GST registry. Buyers see only your verified badge, never your PAN.
company.gstWarn: Your GSTIN is {status} on the GST portal, so your GST verified badge is off. Fix it with your GST officer, then save below to re-check.
company.lastChecked: Last checked {date}. We re-check about once a month.

form.panSaved: Saved: {pan}. Enter again only to change it.
form.panHint: Must match your GSTIN. Stored encrypted.

headline.passed: GST verified. Your badge now shows GST verified.
headline.review: We saved your details. A person on our team will check a few things and confirm, usually within one working day.
headline.unavailable: The GST service is busy right now. Your details are saved. Please try again in a few minutes.
headline.failed: We could not verify this GSTIN.

developers.title: Developers
developers.description: API keys let your systems read leads and manage listings through the REST API or MCP server.

security.title: Security
security.description: Add a second step to sign-in so your leads and credits stay yours.
